slides.texte_overlay:
Simple ways to find
joy in your life again
Do something you loved as a kid. Ride a bike, play football, draw, build something. Old joys often come back faster than you expect.
Eat a good meal slowly. Cook something you love or go to a favourite place. Enjoying food without rushing is a small daily pleasure.
Watch the sunrise or sunset. Ten minutes outside watching the sky reminds you the world is still beautiful. Make it a habit.
Plan a small adventure every month. A new town, a hike, a concert. Something to look forward to brings energy back into ordinary weeks.
Before: days felt the same. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and every day brings something new to wonder about.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: days felt the same. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Every day brings something new to wonder about.

slides.texte_overlay: Spend time with animals. Walk a friend's dog, visit a farm, feed birds in the park. Animals bring simple, honest joy. Even ten minutes help.
Say thank you more often. To friends, family, strangers. Gratitude makes you notice what's good, and joy follows. Start tonight.
